function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA').

unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature values.

function.name: get_snow_report
function.description: Retrieves the latest snow report for a specified location, providing details about the snow conditions and weather. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the snow report, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Aspen, CO'.

unit.description: The temperature unit to be used in the snow report.
